floor_limitation_findings: Sudan, South Sudan, Yemen, Israel and Myanmar are all at composite 0.0 with all eight dimensions at the 1.0 minimum. Every one of their 40 subdimensions is at the low anchor. Further downgrade is arithmetically unavailable. Recorded as a methodology finding, not a score change. This is the second consecutive cycle recording it for Sudan.
Somalia (4.7) has five of eight dimensions at exactly 1.0; total remaining downward room is 4.7 points, below the 5.0 filing trigger, so a downgrade proposal is unavailable.
Haiti (4.7) has five of eight dimensions at exactly 1.0; same 4.7-point limitation.

Democratic Republic of the Congo (2.3) has two dimensions at 1.0 and six between 1.1 and 1.2; total remaining downward room is 2.3 points, less than half the filing trigger. It is already in the lowest band, so the band-crossing clause cannot apply either.

RECOMMENDATION TO COORDINATOR: eight of twenty entities this cycle were evidence-insensitive at or near the floor. Consider a sub-floor severity annotation carried alongside the score so that floor entities remain responsive to evidence. This is a methodology-level question, not a per-cycle score proposal.
date_and_attribution_corrections: SUDAN - ATTRIBUTION CORRECTED: the scanner framed August evidence as RSF-attributed. The 2 August 2026 drone strike on a traditional court at Garra al-Zawaya, North Darfur, killing at least 35, was carried out by the SUDANESE ARMED FORCES (UN News/OCHA, Al Jazeera, Middle East Eye, Sudan Tribune). That is state own-conduct, not paramilitary conduct.

SOUTH SUDAN - GATE WARNING 1 RESOLVED: the superlative claim (36 aid workers killed in 2026, exceeding 31 in all of 2025) was corroborated against a dated UN primary source, the UN Humanitarian Coordinator statement of 19 August 2026, carried verbatim by Xinhua (2026-08-19) and independently by the Washington Post and Sudans Post. Cleared for use.

KAZAKHSTAN - DATE MISMATCH RESOLVED: sentencing occurred 2026-08-18 per CPJ; the radiofree.org URL dated 2026-08-19 is a next-day syndication. FUTURE EVENT VERIFIED: the 23 August 2026 parliamentary election is genuinely scheduled (OSCE ODIHR observation activity) and was NOT scored as conduct.

MASSACHUSETTS - DATE MISMATCH RESOLVED: signing date 2026-08-10 per mass.gov and Boston.com; the 08-11 WBUR item is a next-day report. ACTOR VERIFIED as STATE legislation, not federal, applying the 2026-08-18 Lagos precedent.

MYANMAR - DATE MISMATCH RESOLVED: conduct date 2026-08-10 (airstrikes on Kyauk Gyi village); the 08-11 Washington Post and 08-12 Mizzima items are subsequent reports. ATTRIBUTION: perpetrator is the Myanmar Air Force, unambiguous state own-conduct.

ISRAEL - DATE MISMATCH RESOLVED: briefing date 2026-08-11 per UNSCO and UN News story 1168113; the 08-13 unispal item is an NGO Action News compilation. ATTRIBUTION: applied existing benchmark precedent (2026-05-14, 05-15, 05-28 and 05-29 floor confirmations) rather than re-deciding it.

HARVARD - DATE MISMATCH RESOLVED: two separate events, not a conflict. Court dismissal 2026-08-13; DOJ whistleblower disclosure 2026-08-17 (House Judiciary letter), press coverage 2026-08-18. ATTRIBUTION: neither is Harvard conduct; scored only for what they evidence about Harvard own-conduct.

HAITI - FUTURE EVENT VERIFIED: the 13 December 2026 election is genuinely scheduled by the Provisional Electoral Council (France 24, 2026-07-27; Haitian Times, 2026-07-28), with a 21 February 2027 runoff. NOT scored as conduct. ATTRIBUTION: the 613 deaths in two neighbourhoods are gang conduct; the state is scored on protection failure.

SOMALIA - ATTRIBUTION: the 17 August Baidoa assault was launched by militia loyal to the former state president, not by the state. Scored: the federal decision to fight in a city hosting hundreds of thousands of displaced people, and the resulting civilian deaths.
DR CONGO - ATTRIBUTION: M23 is Rwandan-backed and Wazalendo are irregular militia; neither is scored wholesale against the state. Rwandan troop presence is attributed to Rwanda.

YEMEN - ATTRIBUTION: three actors separated - Houthi de facto authorities, the internationally recognised government, and foreign actors. Foreign-actor strikes are attributed to those actors, not to Yemen.

MARATHON PETROLEUM - ACTOR VERIFIED: the 4-5 August release is company conduct; the TCEQ reports document it. The TCEQ contested-case-hearing vote and Rep. Escobar EPA request are third-party actions and are not scored as Marathon conduct.

INTERPUBLIC GROUP - ATTRIBUTION: the 3,200 roles cut in 2025 are IPG own-conduct while independent and are scored; the 4,000-plus post-merger cuts and brand retirements were announced by OMNICOM and are not scored against IPG.
undated_source_handling: Six entities carried mixed dated/undated sourcing (Kazakhstan, Myanmar, South Sudan, DR Congo, Sudan, Harvard). In every case the undated source was excluded from load-bearing use and the claim was required to rest on at least two independently dated sources.
Excluded from load-bearing use: sudantribune.com/article/317008 (Sudan), english.dvb.no (Myanmar, retained as colour only), friendsofthecongo.org (DR Congo), highereddive.com (Harvard).

false_positive_screening: VENEZUELA was the primary 3e-bis screening test this cycle and the screen held. Venezuela surfaced on POSITIVE evidence (131 political prisoners announced released). A stale-baseline upgrade rationale - that the score predates the removal of Maduro - was explicitly checked and REJECTED: Maduro was removed 2026-01-03; the published 18.0 was applied 2026-04-19 and confirmed on 2026-07-17 and 2026-07-18, all post-transition, all on the current interim government own-conduct. The releases were scored at the independently verified floor (40-43 per Foro Penal and Vente Venezuela) rather than the claimed 131, against 391 still detained. Net movement +0.1. CONFIRMED, not upgraded.

ZAMBIA passed all five 3e-bis screens: baseline provenance verified against three prior assessments (35.9 published, 33.1 on 2026-07-31, 31.9 on 2026-08-18 with an explicit downward watch flag); directionality matches (negative evidence, downgrade proposal); rationale rests on new within-window conduct that post-dates the 08-18 assessment, not on staleness.
NO CALIBRATION CONCERN was encoded as a one-off proposal this cycle. The five seed-cluster corrections are filed as flag-for-review with explicit placeholder framing, per the 2026-08-18 precedent.
proposal_confidence_warnings: FOUR OF SEVEN PROPOSALS ARE LOW CONFIDENCE AND SHOULD NOT BE APPLIED WITHOUT A TARGETED EVIDENCE PASS: Hyatt Hotels, IDEXX Laboratories, Interpublic Group, ManpowerGroup. IDEXX LABORATORIES and MANPOWERGROUP had ZERO adverse evidence of any kind located. Their movement is entirely placeholder correction plus the absence-of-disclosure convention. INTERPUBLIC GROUP: do not apply any score until the entity record is resolved.
